Company’s Policy on Health, Safety, Environment, Quality and Assurance (HSEQA Policy)

The Company Management recognises the necessity and responsibility, not only to provide competent personnel and
well-maintained vessels, but also to promote amongst people working for or on behalf of the Company a high standard
of safety, health, hygiene and environmental awareness. It is the Company Management's belief that such awareness
and commitment which includes pro-active attitudes towards HSEQ issues, must start and transcend from the most
senior management level downwards through the whole spectrum of the organization, including shipboard and shore-
based personnel.

In formulating the HSEQ Policy, the Company Management has identified clearly the objectives and commitment that
are required, within the Safety Management Manual that incorporate all elements of the ISM code and other industry
and legal requirements.

The main objectives of the HSEQ Policy are appended below which are applicable to all people working for or on
behalf of the Company.

To promote safety, hygiene, health and environmental awareness and culture

To provide a safe, healthy and environmentally friendly working environment

To prevent injury, ill health and related losses and aim for zero Lost Time Incidents (LTI's)

To prevent loss of, or damage to property and strive for Zero incidents in all activities

To identify vessel, personnel and environmental hazards and mitigate risks

To provide proper training and supervision for all staff

To identify and assess health hazards and mitigate risks through risk assessments and safety meetings

To develop and implement HSEQ Management procedures by encouraging best practices

To continuously maintain, review, solicit feedback and improve upon the HSEQ objectives & performance

To interact with the Maritime Industry to share and apply best practices to activities Company engage in

To prevent pollution and to set objectives and targets to reduce environmental impact

To achieve “Zero Pollution Incidents” on our vessels

To reduce the quantity of permitted emissions.

To ensure compliance with applicable codes, guidelines and standards recommended by the IMO, ILO, Flag State
and local Legislation, Classification Societies and Maritime Industry.

The Company Management has therefore endorsed a complete and comprehensive HSEQ Safety Management
Manual that clearly identifies in detail the procedures and measures required to achieve these objectives, The manual
also stresses the importance of giving a high priority and compliance to clients’ own rules, regulations and standards.
This manual will be kept under constant review and revised accordingly in line with new/changed regulations,
Company initiatives and to meet or exceed Client expectations.
